reason: The section covers credit and debit adjustments when payment-in-lieu grant amounts differ.

proposedGroups.reason: Both subsections address differences between amounts paid to the municipality and amounts received by the Province.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how underpayments and overpayments tied to Payments in Lieu of Taxes Act grants are credited or debited in the second next ensuing year.

reason: The section covers public inspection of municipal documents with a closed-meeting exception.

proposedGroups.reason: Both subsections address available documents and closed meeting minutes.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall which municipal minutes, financial statements, estimates, and records are open to public inspection and the closed-meeting exception.

reason: Section 89 combines borrowing authority and limits with separate general-fund surplus and deficit adjustments.

proposedGroups.reason: These subsections cover borrowing authority, limits, plebiscite authority, maximum constraints, net borrowing, and exclusions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall municipal borrowing authority and the current-operation, capital-expenditure, plebiscite, maximum, net-amount, and excluded-borrowing rules.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: General fund surplus and deficit adjustments
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections address crediting surplus and debiting deficit to the current fund.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how audited general fund surplus and deficit are carried into the current fund for the second next ensuing year.

reason: The section states one authority for operating and capital reserve funds.

evidenceText:
establish, manage and contribute to

(a)
an operating reserve fund

proposedGroups.reason: The target is a focused reserve-fund authority.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that a municipality may establish, manage, and contribute to operating and capital reserve funds in accordance with regulations.

reason: Section 90.01 separates eligible grant recipients and benefit scope from tax-charge limits and differentiation.

proposedGroups.reason: These subsections identify eligible recipients, partial or outside benefit, and rural community application.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall who may receive municipal grants and when grants may benefit part of a municipality, outside recipients, or a rural community.

proposedGroups.reason: These subsections prohibit tax or utility reimbursement and allow differentiation among recipients.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the tax or utility charge restriction on grants and how council may differentiate among potential grant recipients.

reason: Section 90.1 is a long conflict-of-interest definitions section; most terms group cleanly, but two tail definitions require human review because the same-source context representation is truncated.

proposedGroups.reason: These terms define people, boards, and organizations used in the conflict provisions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the conflict-of-interest meanings of charitable organization, family associate, local board, and member.

proposedGroups.reason: These terms define company status and interest concepts used to identify financial conflicts.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the company, controlling-interest, and senior-officer terms used in the conflict-of-interest provisions.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Employment and senior appointed officer terms
proposedGroups.reason: These terms define employment and senior appointed officer roles.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what employ means and which responsibilities are included in senior appointed officer.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Senior officer and service club terms
proposedGroups.reason: The target also defines senior officer and service club, but those tail definitions need human review because the same-source context representation is truncated.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the senior officer and service club definitions after human review of section 90.1.

reason: Section 90.2 separates general financial-interest conflicts from a trade-union collective-agreement conflict.

proposedGroups.reason: These subsections define conflicts through personal, family, company, and financial benefits plus knowledge of family interests.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a member or senior appointed officer has a conflict through contracts, financial benefits, family associates, companies, or controlling interests.

proposedGroups.reason: This subsection creates a specific conflict rule for collective-agreement matters.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when trade union membership or employment creates a conflict for collective-agreement matters.

reason: Section 90.3 lists many conflict exceptions and is clearer as two exception groups.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Common voter service deposit and office exceptions

evidenceText: a qualified voter, an owner-occupier of residential property, or a user of any public utility service
entitled to receive on terms common to other persons any service or commodity or any subsidy, loan or other such benefit
a person who has made a deposit with a municipality or local board
eligible for election or appointment to fill a vacancy, office or position

proposedGroups.reason: These clauses exclude conflicts based on common voter or service status, common benefits, debentures or deposits, and eligibility for vacancies.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the conflict exceptions for qualified voters, utility users, common municipal benefits, debentures, deposits, and eligibility for office or position vacancies.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Land remuneration organization and remote-interest exceptions

evidenceText: an interest in land valued in use as farm land or farm woodlot
in receipt of an allowance for attendance at meetings
an honorary member of a trade union
an interest which is so remote or insignificant
a member or officer of a service club or charitable organization

proposedGroups.reason: These clauses exclude conflicts based on farm land, roles, remuneration, honorary membership, remote interests, and organizations.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the conflict exceptions for farm land, municipal company or board roles, remuneration, honorary union membership, common or remote interests, and service-club or charitable-organization roles.

reason: Section 90.4 separates written conflict disclosure filings from meeting disclosure and withdrawal duties.

proposedGroups.reason: These subsections require initial and later filed conflict statements.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when members must file written conflict-of-interest statements and that financial particulars need not be disclosed.

proposedGroups.reason: This subsection governs disclosure and withdrawal when a conflict matter is considered at a meeting.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a member must disclose a conflict at a meeting and withdraw while the matter is considered or voted on.

reason: The section is a focused disclosure rule for senior appointed officers.

proposedGroups.reason: Both subsections require initial and later conflict statements filed with the clerk.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when senior appointed officers must file conflict-of-interest disclosure statements and what particulars need not be disclosed.

reason: The section covers recording, filing, public inspection, meeting minutes, and qualification date for conflict declarations.

proposedGroups.reason: All subsections address conflict disclosure records and inspection.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how conflict disclosures and verbal declarations are recorded, kept, inspected, and tied to elector qualification dates.

reason: Section 90.7 separates deemed quorum from the Minister order process when quorum is not attained.

proposedGroups.reason: This subsection states when remaining members are deemed to constitute quorum.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when remaining members are deemed to constitute quorum after conflict withdrawals.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Minister order when quorum not attained
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections allow an application and Minister order permitting consideration, discussion, and voting.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how council or a local board may seek a Minister order when conflict withdrawals leave too few members for quorum.

reason: Section 90.8 contains a narrow advice exception and separate benefit and personal-gain prohibitions.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Requested advice exception for senior appointed officer
proposedGroups.reason: This subsection permits requested advice within employment where the conflict is known.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a senior appointed officer may provide requested advice despite a conflict of interest.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Fees gifts and personal gain prohibitions
proposedGroups.reason: This subsection prohibits influential benefits and use of position or information for personal or family-associate gain.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the prohibitions on influential benefits and personal-gain use of position or privileged information.
